title: C# programming practice with GPT-4 compiler-error hints
summary: Students solve a series of optional C# programming problems in an automated assessment platform. For the experimental group, GPT-4 explains the first compiler error and suggests a strategy on 71 tasks, while later tasks omit hints to test transfer.

sources.title: Navigating Compiler Errors with AI Assistance - A Study of GPT Hints in an Introductory Programming Course
sources.evidence_quote: Usage of the platform was not mandatory and performance did not count towards the final grade.

assessment.summary: Solve C# problems covering variables, conditionals, recursion, loops, and arrays.
student_actions: Review compiler messages, unit-test results, and optional GPT hints.
Revise and resubmit without an attempt limit.

student_role.description: GPT-4 generated Polish-language compiler-error explanations, solution strategies, and concept reminders after erroneous submissions.

grading.method: Performance was displayed as the percentage of unit tests passed but did not count toward the final grade.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: Ninety-seven novices were assigned to control and experimental groups; 61 used the platform, producing 14,830 submissions and 1,222 GPT hints.

evidence_excerpts.quote: Usage of the platform was not mandatory and performance did not count towards the final grade.
